title: OPD-V: Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation with Modality Balance
abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has become a standard post-training approach for improving visual reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing methods draw privileged information from diverse input sources to guide self-distillation. Yet these designs overlook Modality Imbalance, a challenge inherent to MLLM reasoning. When textual information dominates generation, the model cannot fully integrate its multimodal input. Consequently, carefully designed privileged information remains underused, limiting the effectiveness of OPSD. To examine this limitation, we construct a Positive Teacher with the Zoom-In Image and a Negative Teacher with the Mask Image, which exhibit different degrees of Modality Imbalance. Changes in their reasoning correctness and token logits reveal that Modality Balance can itself serve as privileged information. Motivated by this finding, we introduce OPD-V, a visual OPSD paradigm that instantiates such information through the Positive Teacher and Negative Teacher. Positive Modality-Balance Logits Margins define a Modality-Balance Trust Region that selects the on-policy tokens used for self-distillation. Experiments across 6 benchmarks, 4 MLLM backbones, and 5 post-training methods show that OPD-V consistently improves reasoning performance while reducing training cost.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2608.05131v1 全文整理；截至本次全文审阅，论文未在 PDF 中提供可用的公开代码 URL。
analysis.ideaZh: 用 Zoom-In positive teacher 与 Mask negative teacher 对同一条 student rollout 重新打分，只蒸馏那些更受视觉证据支持的 on-policy tokens。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它直接研究 MLLM visual reasoning post-training，并把模型是否真正利用图像转化为 token-level selection signal；这一思路也可迁移到需要视觉证据约束的 design agent。
analysis.evidenceZh: 作者报告 Qwen3.5-4B 的六项 benchmark-level 非加权平均由 64.30 提升至 80.01，matched Vision-OPD 为 77.10（Table 1, p. 6）；4B/9B 的平均 step time 分别下降 31.8%/24.7%（Fig. 5, pp. 8–9）。
analysis.caveatZh: Zoom-In view 依赖 Vision-OPD 已提供的 evidence-centered bbox；论文没有 bbox-free、crop-quality 或 multi-seed 实验，80.01 也不是按 32,162 个样本加权的 pooled accuracy。
analysis.motivationZh: 普通 OPSD 即使获得 privileged input，student generation 仍可能主要由文字先验支配。作者因此尝试显式比较增强视觉证据与削弱视觉证据后，每个已生成 token 的支持度是否真的发生了有利变化。
analysis.methodZh: Student 先在原图上产生 on-policy response。Positive Teacher 使用 evidence-centered Zoom-In crop，Negative Teacher 使用随机 Mask view，对完全相同的 student tokens 逐项重新打分；二者 log probability 差形成 Modality-Balance Logits Margin。只有正 margin tokens 进入 trust region，并按 margin 加权 Positive Teacher 与 student 的 Jensen–Shannon distillation loss，teacher 通过 EMA 更新。
analysis.experimentsZh: 作者使用 6,241 条带 verified target 与 bbox crop 的 Vision-OPD synthetic samples，在四个 Qwen3-VL/Qwen3.5 backbones 和六项 high-resolution/visual-reasoning benchmarks 上测试。作者报告跨 backbone 平均均有提升，例如 Qwen3-VL-4B 68.00→74.14、Qwen3-VL-8B 68.93→73.03、Qwen3.5-9B 69.75→77.63（Fig. 4, pp. 7–8）；dual-teacher ablation 为 80.01，高于 positive-only 74.62 与 negative-only 71.98（Fig. 6, pp. 9–10）。
analysis.insightZh: Negative teacher 最有价值的角色不是提供另一个 target distribution，而是作为反事实参照，判断 privileged visual view 何时真的比削弱视觉后的模型更可信。可迁移的设计原则是先验证 teacher signal 的视觉归因，再决定是否蒸馏。
